## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      4 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 24.08.2026 - 27.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Bug with Premium_, 27.08.2026, 2/5: "I paid for a full year of premium, but when I went to cancel the auto renew scheduled for next July, I started getting ads in the app. I don’t see a way to restore my purchase and remove the ads. I’m paying for a premium, ad-free service. This feels like a bug. Can we fix?"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs und Stabilität** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs und Stabilität.**
      5 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen bugs und stabilität.
      Review-Fenster: 18.06.2026 - 27.08.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Crashes oder Instabilität. Nur bei Volume-Spike oder nach einem Update als actionable werten; sonst oft Baseline-Rauschen.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Hulafhj_, 26.08.2026, 1/5: "MyFitnessPal is getting too complicated… Navigating the APP, adding food and etc is starting to feel like I’m jumping thru hoops and now the apps keeps freezing…I deleted and ddl it several times…still the same problem. This App no longer suits me…which is a shame…I lost 70lbs using your app in 2019. 😩damned myself by buying a year subscription"
            2. _Verczeska_, 24.08.2026, 1/5: "I have been a user since early 2010s. I loved it and I recommended it to all friends, family and clients. The new update made it all unusable, I find it hard to see what I actually consumed. Bring the old version back."
            3. _Jen,seeking resolution_, 17.08.2026, 1/5: "Terrible navigation, continually have Mondays entries end up on the following Sunday, no longer is there mass delete, various editing functions gone, way more clicks to add and delete, hideous UI and UX, glitchy. Did anyone bother to even do a feature gap analysis before deploying this junk that has had nothing but terrible reviews none of which have they remedied or even addressed? Boycot these people"
<!--/ir-theme-->
